purpose: Teach: 取りまとめ/ファックス/激励/主査/次官/母体/個室/衣服

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、社員意見の取りまとめを大事にされた
lines.en: When Dad founded the company, he made it a priority to gather and listen to his employees' ideas.
lines.style: Warm, measured recollection. Slight pause after each phrase — not rushed, but thoughtful. The cadence of someone sharing something worth remembering. Gentle respect in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはファックスでも丁寧に連絡された
lines.en: Yes. He was always careful and thoughtful with every communication — even the faxes.
lines.style: Quiet agreement. A small, genuine smile underneath. Not performing reverence, but acknowledging the detail with recognition. Steady, almost gentle affirmation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社員への激励の手紙も書かれた
lines.en: He also wrote encouraging letters to his staff. By hand.
lines.style: Softer now. A slight catch of emotion — not sadness, but the weight of remembering care that was real. Pace slows. Voice trails gently on 'hand'.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは主査クラスの育成に注力された
lines.en: Yes. He invested heavily in developing the managers — getting them ready to lead.
lines.style: Steady, reflective tone. A note of quiet pride underneath. Not boastful — factual, but said with feeling. Slight emphasis on 'invested', as if that word carries the full weight of what it meant.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、業界の元次官とも親交があられた
lines.en: He even had relationships with senior people in the industry — the former vice-minister included.
lines.style: Eyes on something distant. Slow, deliberate pacing. A subtle note of wonder — how remarkable that felt at the time. Slight trailing-off, as if the reach of it still surprises.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは会社の母体価値を高められた
lines.en: Yes. Through all of it, he raised the company's core values. That was the real work.
lines.style: Quiet wisdom. Slower tempo. The voice of someone who has understood something over time. Not explaining — affirming. Weight rests on 'core values'.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、商談用の個室も自ら設計された
lines.en: He even designed the private meeting rooms himself. Every detail mattered to him.
lines.style: Slight wonder in the delivery. Paced to let the particularity land — 'designed the private meeting rooms himself' — as if the specificity itself says something. Trailing softly on 'himself'.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員衣服にもこだわられた
lines.en: Yes. He even paid attention to how his staff dressed — what they wore mattered as part of the company's character.
lines.style: Closing affirmation. Warmth and finality together. A slow, concluding pace. Slight emphasis on 'character', as if that's the point being made. Dignified, gentle close.
